checks.finding: Primary Methods explicitly reports available-case analyses and complete observations for each paired time comparison, with no formal missing-data methods. The audit attributes this to the publication and does not claim the executed data or code were reproduced.

FAS 13, safety 12, mFAS 12 and 11 completers remain distinct. P3 received zinc but is excluded from mFAS; never-exposed P8 remains in mFAS and is excluded from safety. These memberships do not supply actual outcome availability.
checks.locator: Methods; Figure 1; Results on P3/P8, retrieved lines 299-313

checks.finding: The published 11/13 FAS and 10/12 mFAS feasibility results, plus P3 prewithdrawal adherence, support the explicitly labeled set-accounting inference. Neither feasible set is silently replaced by the completer set; the unidentified other failure remains null. Feasibility is not an efficacy response rate.

All 21 observed-visit and 14 general complete-pair query slots remain null. The seven outcomes and day 0/90/180 slots are explicit; queried contrasts are not asserted to have published results. No denominator is reconstructed from mFAS size, completer count, plotted dots or nominal P values.

Extracted main-text means, SDs and four nominal baseline-to-six-month P values match the source. The blinded BFMDRS movement assessment remains distinct from unblinded disability and caregiver measures, and the unchanged movement finding is retained.
The difference between reported GMFM visit means is not promoted to a verified within-person mean change while contributor identity and paired N remain unknown. No participant values were imputed.

Paired t-test/Wilcoxon options, exploratory normality checks, post-hoc Wilcoxon sensitivity, two-sided nominal P values and lack of multiplicity adjustment agree with the main text. Per-comparison test assignment and numeric sensitivity results remain unresolved without the appendix.

Known n=8 complete GMFM pairs belong to the age-restricted CP reference-trajectory comparison. A separate propensity-matched analysis is identified, with achieved matched-group Ns and matching details unresolved. Neither becomes a concurrent GNAO1 control.

Full main HTML access is distinguished from unread appendix, protocol and registry content. The source describes future controlled access to individual data/scripts; the audit makes no request, substitutes no synthetic data and leaves registry hasResults null.
checks.locator: Data sharing statement and Appendix A

checks.finding: Strict JSON and source IDs pass. Existing candidate identity, reserve, asset hold and zero new dedicated allocation remain; seven outcome records do not become extra candidates or efficacy replications.

primary_sources_independently_checked.access: Primary main-text HTML: Methods, analysis sets, figure captions, outcome and feasibility Results, data sharing and appendix identification. No full supplement or protocol contents.
